decisions.reason: Having already outlasted the parallel resin-injection experiment, this unit remains a credible option in a core equipment niche and is worth retaining unless sales clearly disappoint.
The automatic airless spray gun sits close to the firm’s established spray-application capabilities, so carrying it another year has low cost and preserves useful market coverage.
A manual airless spray gun is a highly standard, well-aligned offering for this customer base, making withdrawal unlikely unless demand is plainly weak.
This multi-model air-assisted airless line offers broad option value across segments in the firm’s core business, so management would normally continue it.
The data logger is still the most uncertain because it reaches beyond the firm’s traditional hardware focus, but it complements the installed base and remains worth keeping as a smaller option.
